summary: The Backrooms is a shared multiplayer survival RPG spanning the Level 0 maze, mall, The Hub and authored destinations. Player state carries progression, gear, quests and resume location; shared registries/helpers and per-place simulations supply navigation, NPCs, story and world dressing. Chapter 2's Level ! rescue points through the Safe Alcove's south door into seeded streamed Level 109, a Neon Hospital with department rooms, frenzied wanderers, containment pens and a sealed B3 dungeon.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and deterministic dressing; momentsV gates fitted wall moments and room-prop regeneration.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; authored placements live in cells/.
places/thehub (3D) - expanded tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations, Doorstep Carpet and Camp Amber crews; separate from Bonus room routing.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office, supplies, HALOGEN machine, encounters and story beats.
places/level1 + places/level4 (3D) - M.E.G. camps and authored office mazes; sims dress story props and facilities.
places/level9 + places/level11 (3D) - The Suburbs seeded streets and Level 11's city/Base Beta/strip mall/clinic, IS LAB signal bench, payphone and Chapter 2 entry trail.
places/level61 (3D, The Snackrooms) - food court and M.E.G. checkpoint with storefronts, simulated staff/services and Clippers cocktail lounge.

places/level109 + places/levelrun (3D) - Level ! chase/rescue ends in Phoebe's Safe Alcove; its south cream door enters the seeded streamed Neon Hospital, with department rooms, locked wanderer dens and sealed B3 dungeon.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input actions; fall-guard runs before locomotion/player behavior.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local config, authored placements and place generation/tick behavior; Level 61 and Level ! delegate dressing to shared helpers.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts + scripts/ui.js - title/settings/pause, character creation and arrival; lifecycle/tutorial beats and composed HUD/menus.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player actions/state, wake/resume, aiming, third-person view and per-place zone resolution.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + xmas-room.js + level0-moments.js - Level 0 layout and deterministic maze dressing/encounters; moments version gates rebuilds.
places/thehub/sim.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + hub-people.js + hub-dress.js + scripts/thehub-geo.js - Hub topology, doors, dressing and crew; Phoebe shares scripts/lib/phoebe.js dressing.
scripts/talk.js + scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js and level quest modules - dialogue, quest journal/markers and shared advancement/reward rules.

places/level109/sim.js + scripts/lib/level109.js - seeded corridor/room streaming, per-department dressing, wanderer dens and containment adapters; scripts/lib/levelrun-quest.js remains the separate Level ! chase entry.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical per-place names, labels and HUD titles; consumed by feed, quest names and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/caching/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 path adapters.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - common pursuit/lurk/wake/retreat/bite behavior configured by scripts/lib/l34-smiler.js and scripts/lib/l9-smiler.js.
scripts/lib/carry.js + scripts/lib/companion.js - threshold-crossing transfer of held props and nearby following companions; companion recruitment, orders, perks and lifecycle.
scripts/lib/hub.js + preload data/scripts - Bonus shared-room routing, solo IDs, home destinations, labels and proximity preload; distinct from places/thehub.
scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - canonical Hub tunnels, open/keyed/sealed door registry, key inventory and positions; shared by geometry, simulation, quests, doors and UI.

scripts/lib/containment.js - Level 109 persistent pen/loose-foe, open-door and remembered-door-position books; sim supplies room IDs/boxes and spawnFoe adapter, while pen keeper and pen-door handle AI and player door movement.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js + scripts/lib/ui-theme.js - escaping, preference normalization, Escape handling, empty states, notice toasts and shared dialogue styling.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; per-level path adapters retain their level-specific cell/block rules and exports.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js expose update with separate configurations.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.

scripts/lib/quests.js - shared journal, advancement and reward helpers; scripts/lib/containment.js - containment state and pen/door operations; scripts/lib/ch2-quest.js - CH2, CH2_ECHO, CH2_TONE, syncCh2 variants and quest stages/dialogue choices.
scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js - CORRIDOR, OBSTACLES, agilityProfile, hitObstacle, stepHordeZ; scripts/lib/level109.js - seeded corridor/room layout math and coordinate helpers.

scripts/lib/level109-quest.js - QID, QNAME, BREACH, Q, questTick, dialogue handler/choices; l109-b3.js - B3 origin/room geometry, stairDoorAt, buildB3 and placeLauncher; l109-foes.js - MGR, spawnFoe; l109-wanderers.js - BARKS, DEN, denOf/denLoad/denLock/denWatch/denUnload/wandererTick.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression, XP/level, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, currency, karma/rep and homeKeep.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats derived stats.
scripts/critter.js - per-player look and creator/wardrobe/salon state; scripts/lib/seat.js - player.state.sit; scripts/lib/body3.js - session.ready3 and transient melee-carry pose.
scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - player quest journal/tracking/completion/claim keys; Dina trail stages, diary/cut/clue fields and migration.
scripts/lib/errands.js - player.state.errands, errHints and journal entries; completion updates currency, payout, reputation and hints; field-errands.js + hub-errands.js own confirmation maps.

Level quest modules (including level8/10/11/21/61, level31, level70, remodel, ch2 and zenith) - level-specific stages/routes/outcomes; ch2-quest.js owns Chapter 2 main/echo/tone progress, clues, alternate-path flags and payouts.
scripts/lib/companion.js - NPC follow/loyalty/perk/order/weapon state plus player.state.crew; scripts/lib/carry.js records player.state.xferTo and coordinates transfer on threshold links.

places/level109/sim.js owns place.state.l109seed and B3 spawn timing; scripts/lib/containment.js writes place.state.pens/loose/pdoors/pdoorAt; l109-wanderers.js books den refill timestamps in place.state.dens; Level 109 quest progress is player.state.l109q.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest and CCTV behaviors; scripts/interact.js handles tagged-seat selection and seatTick.

templates/player.js runs scripts/fall-guard.js update before movement; place changes hold velocity for ground streaming, grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; body3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; periodic saves exclude intake, bonus and tutorial0.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; threshold door handlers call carryAcross → held props and nearby following companions cross; Bonus/world/room links are excluded.
scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone; scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles, markers and compass place names.
scripts/main-menu-ui.js settings → scripts/main-menu.js handler → player.state.uiPrefs; scripts/ui.js wraps composed UI with ui-kit preference attributes and renders quest/feed/HUD panels.
scripts/player.js writes player.state.notice and scripts/stats.js forwards fresh notices into feed → scripts/ui.js renders ui-kit noticeToast; feed status watcher uses canonical place labels.
scripts/main-menu.js errandTick → scripts/lib/errands.js offers place-matched jobs; carried items/kills/world events advance errands → journal, player.state.errands/qtrack and payouts.

scripts/talk.js → dialogue.js rootChoices and quest handlers; level quest modules call scripts/lib/quests.js → journal/feed/reputation/reward state; Hub route/quest logic consumes thehub door registry and visit/clue flags.

scripts/lib/ch2-quest.js stages/markers → Level 11 clues, Gamma/IS LAB routes and Level !; Level ! rescue + Phoebe completion unlock Chapter 3 and mark lrun-to-l109, the south cream door to Level 109.

places/level109/sim.js tick → seeded streamed halls/rooms, roomLook/buildRoom, den and containment adapters, wanderer encounters and Level 109 questTick; room props flush in batches of 30 per tick, unload persists pen state, and l109-wanderers uses the frenzied wardrobe from clothes.yml.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon + places/level61/sim.js and scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - authored commercial interiors and simulated staff/services; menus/staff vary by venue and Level 6.1 fixtures are fitted separately.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes a table with two separately fitted chairs.

art/cigs/build.py + art/fnv/build.py + art/xmas-clean/build.py and NIF converters → fitted GLBs and prop catalogs; xmas-clean prepares Tripo Christmas models with canonical facing, floor origin and reduced meshes/textures.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
Level 01/Zenith and Level 1 geometry builders - authored station and car park/service geometry; corridor materials, pipes, fixtures and lights vary deterministically per cell.

scripts/meg-agent.js + npc-temper.js + forgive.js + critter-model.js + companion.js - NPC reactions, cover, barks, combat and following vary by faction/role/outfit/perk; Hub and story Phoebes share phoebe.js dressing.

scripts/lib/level109.js + l109-rooms.js + data/l109-rooms.yml - seeded department rooms share fitted room/loot builders, varying by room type, clean/abandoned roll, light colour, ambience and contents; supply rooms now fill eight numbered aisles around a locked cage, while ICU/ward layouts use configurable bed rows. l109-wanderers + data/clothes.yml gives hostile encounters the frenzied gown/scrubs/straitjacket wardrobe.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs, destinations and coordinates together; place.state.hubV gates shell/door/plaque rebuilds.

Hub keyed doors consume the matching player.state.hubKeys key; t10-a3 maps to level11 and hubTenthCrossed is set only after a qualifying clue and successful crossing; Level 1's route is a separate threshold pair.

Level 109's place.state.l109seed fixes irregular corridor/room rolls across reloads; keep arrival room-pop and den safe radii coupled to scripts/lib/level109.js SPAWN; dens refill on an hourly place.state.dens timestamp after their lockpick door is opened.

Level 109 containment is keyed by room ID in pens, loose and pdoors; pdoorAt remembers door coordinates so books behind an open door in an unloaded room can move to loose. Pen doors are player-operated, not AI-opened; their interaction state c is at mid-height for gaze targeting. B3 is below the hospital floor (origin y=-14); keep B3 positions/colliders and b3-mob state coupled.

Level ! intro must still trigger even if a player is already past corridorStartZ; the chase activates only after lrunIntroDone. Chapter 2 archive/signal clues can arrive out of stage order; Phoebe's south cream door ID lrun-to-l109 and quest/arrival flags remain linked.
